violated_contract: A cache reconcile that is the only tombstone path for rows deleted elsewhere must not end its run without a prune or a scheduled retry when the server truncates. The list view renders the server-authoritative page, but search reads the local cache, so a synced row whose local tombstone was never set stays searchable for the rest of the session when the reconcile gives up on a truncated pull and waits for the next launch.
canonical_prevention: Schedule a bounded in-launch retry (monotonic backoff, capped attempts) that re-enters the same guarded reconcile path — fresh cursor, owner-authorization re-check before every prune — and emit outcome telemetry (complete / truncated_exhausted / aborted_owner_changed / failed) so the failure class is measurable. Latch only on a complete pull; an exhausted run stays unlatched so the next launch retries.
